This VCF contains no homozygous-reference genotypes at any of PharmCAT's required positions, which means it is almost certainly a variants-only file. Such a file is indistinguishable from one where those positions were never tested, and the consequence is NOT a missing result — it is a confident WRONG result: a change whose key position is missing is invisible, so the genotype reads as reference and a reduced-function patient is reported as normal. Measured rate of confidently-wrong calls at 60% position coverage: up to 28.6%. Produce the file again with EVERY position reported — including the ones that match the reference — so each required position carries an explicit genotype. The input requirements page gives the exact commands. See docs/input_requirements.md.

This VCF contains no homozygous-reference genotypes at any of PharmCAT's required positions, which means it is almost certainly a variants-only file. Such a file is indistinguishable from one where those positions were never tested. For a genotype caller that reads a missing position as reference, the consequence is NOT a missing result — it is a confident WRONG result: a change whose key position is missing is invisible, so a reduced-function patient is reported as normal. Measured rate of confidently-wrong calls at 60% position coverage: up to 28.6%. This application therefore reports genes without their required positions as Unknown rather than as normal. Produce the file again with EVERY position reported — including the ones that match the reference — so each required position carries an explicit genotype. D16.analyze.json.final: Research/educational decision support only. Not a medical device. Not for clinical use. No qualified clinical expert has reviewed this text. Recommendation text is quoted from CPIC via PharmCAT, and automated source checks are not human review: they cannot show that every statement is supported or that it is correct for you.

removed: No qualified clinical expert has reviewed these explanations. This system writes no clinical content of its own: every clinical statement is machine-verified to trace to a CPIC recommendation issued by PharmCAT, or to a cited mechanism document. That checks provenance, not correctness.

D16.coverage.json.baseline: Defined by copy-number and structural variation, which a VCF cannot express. A different kind of genetic test is needed; no VCF will resolve it.
D16.coverage.json.final: Not called from an uploaded VCF by this application: CYP2D6 results depend on copy-number and structural variation, which need specialised read-level calling. Uploading a different VCF here will not resolve it.
